question: Who wrote the play 'Mudrarakshasa'?
solution: The correct answer is **__Vishakhadatta.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The Book Mudrarakshasa is written by **Vishakhadatta.** • He was an Indian Sanskrit poet and playwright. • Only two plays of Vishakhadatta, which are the** Mudrārākṣasa and the Devichandraguptam **are very known to us. • Vishakhadatta was a contemporary of** Chandragupta 2 **and lived in the late **4th century to early 5th century in History.** • Mudrārākṣasa is Vishakhadatta’s only surviving play till now, although there exist fragments of another work ascribed to him. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Somadeva, a Kashmiri Brahman** of the Śaiva sect and Sanskrit writer who served much of India’s ancient folklore in the form of a series of tales in verse. • **Baudhayana** is said to be the original Mathematician behind the Pythagoras theorem in India. • Kālidāsa was a Classical Sanskrit author his plays and poetry are primarily based on the Vedas, the Rāmāyaṇa, the Mahābhārata and the Purāṇas. 6f:T1094,
